name: DBSCAN
tagline: Density-based clustering: connects core points within $\epsilon$ and labels low-density regions as noise.
pseudocode:
1. Set min_samples = 10, eps based on dim: 0.22 for low-D StandardScaled, else Kneedle on k-distance graph.
2. For each $x_i$: count $|\{x_j : \|x_i - x_j\| \le \epsilon\}|$; mark core if count $\ge$ min_samples.
3. Build $\epsilon$-neighborhood graph among core points; assign each connected component a cluster id.
4. Assign border points (within $\epsilon$ of a core) to that core's cluster.
5. Remaining points labeled $-1$ (noise).
diff_from_baseline: Ester, Kriegel, Sander, Xu 1996 (KDD) — sklearn.cluster.DBSCAN. Density-based clustering of applications with noise; the standard density-cluster baseline.

name: HDBSCAN
tagline: Hierarchical density-based clustering with mutual reachability and stability-based cluster extraction.
pseudocode:
1. Compute mutual reachability distance $d_{mr}(x_i, x_j) = \max(\mathrm{core}_k(x_i), \mathrm{core}_k(x_j), d(x_i, x_j))$.
2. Build minimum spanning tree on $d_{mr}$.
3. Construct cluster hierarchy by removing edges in decreasing order.
4. Extract flat clustering via excess-of-mass (EOM) stability selection with min_cluster_size.
5. Fallback: if all points labeled noise, run KMeans with $k = $ n_clusters.
diff_from_baseline: Campello, Moulavi, Sander 2013 — sklearn.cluster.HDBSCAN. SOTA density-based method that auto-selects number of clusters; eliminates DBSCAN's eps parameter via hierarchy + stability.

name: K-Means
tagline: Centroid-based clustering minimizing within-cluster squared Euclidean distance (Lloyd's algorithm).
formula: $$\min_{C_1,...,C_k, \mu_1,...,\mu_k} \sum_{c=1}^{k} \sum_{x \in C_c} \| x - \mu_c \|^2 \\ \text{Lloyd: assign } C_c = \{x : c = \arg\min_j \|x - \mu_j\|\}, \quad \mu_c \leftarrow \frac{1}{|C_c|} \sum_{x \in C_c} x$$
diff_from_baseline: Lloyd 1957 / MacQueen 1967 — sklearn.cluster.KMeans. Default centroid-based baseline; assumes convex, isotropic clusters of similar size.
